providers.lead: Your API keys, encrypted and scoped to your organization. One service per row.
providers.title: Providers

field.dailyCap: Daily call cap — defaults to 20 (free tier)
field.enrichDailyCapHint: Contacts enriched per day, at most. Set 0 to pause automatic enrichment and enrich by hand only, from the Signals screen.
field.scoreDailyCapHint: Signals processed per day by the scoring AI, all sources included. Set 0 to pause scoring.
field.emailDailyCapHint: Emails pushed to SalesBlink per day, all campaigns (0 = pause, empty = unlimited)
field.syncIntervalMinHint: How often Jay Reach reads sends, replies and bounces from SalesBlink (2 to 60)
field.replyMaxDelayHHint: Past this delay, a follow-up still queued at SalesBlink is re-sent as a new "Re:" email (1 to 72)

sources.title: Watch themes
sources.lead: What you watch, and where. Keywords are entered once per theme and apply to all its providers.
sources.empty: No watch theme yet. Create one to start detecting signals.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.lead: Reply at the right moment — and know whether you already replied elsewhere.
inbox.replyNote: Sending always goes through the channel of the received message — never another.
inbox.replyImpossible: Can't reply: no received message on this thread.
inbox.replyEmailOnly: Replying from Jay Reach only works on email threads. LinkedIn is coming later.
inbox.buySignal: Buy signal: departure detected → the account resurfaces to find the successor.
inbox.empty: Choose a thread to read it.
inbox.sorted: {n, plural, one {# reply sorted} other {# replies sorted}}

campaignNew.title: Create a campaign
campaignNew.lead: Where prospects come from, who to target, and at what pace. The sequence is built next.
campaignNew.demoNotice: Connect Supabase to create a campaign.
campaignNew.name: Name
campaignNew.minScoreHelp: Score the AI gives each contact, 0 to 100, following their persona’s scoring brief. Below this threshold, the contact does not enter.
campaignNew.dailyCapHelp: All channels combined. If the LinkedIn settings are stricter, those apply: the tighter limit always wins.
